hints: indeg[v] counts edges pointing INTO v. Build it by looping over every vertex's adjacency list and incrementing the target.
Each round: take a vertex with indeg 0, output it, and decrement the indegree of everything it points to - as if deleting it from the graph.
If at some round no vertex has indeg 0 but vertices remain, what is left must contain a cycle, so return 0. That doubles as cycle detection.
title: Topological sort (Kahn), lexicographically smallest
